chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Excellent indeed is a gift given before a need is presented.

key_terms.الشَّيْءُ: the matter or thing being praised
key_terms.الْحَاجَةِ: a need or occasion of need
key_terms.الْهَدِيَّةُ: a gift freely given as an act of goodwill
key_terms.نِعْمَ: an expression of praise meaning how excellent or how good

ai.seo_question: Why is giving a gift before someone asks considered excellent in Islam?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام praises the giving of a gift before a request or need is expressed. It teaches refined social conduct, generosity, and attentiveness to the needs of others before they are forced to ask.
